steps.step: re-apply after rollback matches first apply

deviations: Question raised with ask_human, answer deferred: when the latest earlier year that has an eligible invoice got payment method 0 Unknown or payer type 0 Unknown, a later year with no invoice carries that 0 with carried flag 1. This follows the literal wording of RULE-016 and RULE-022. The alternative would be 0 with flag 0. Unit test: 'Unknown method of an invoiced year is carried with flag 1'.

Same deferred question: an eligible invoice from 2022 onward in a year before the contact's first-event year can be carried into later years. Carry-forward looks at all of the contact's segment invoices from 2022, not only the years that have attributes rows.

Same deferred question: a double payment (Corporate plus another method) where the contact has no live subscription is Individual even without a Phase 1 paid position. This follows RULE-026 ('otherwise Individual'). 'Another method' is any qualifying payment line whose mapped method is not Corporate, including -1 Unrecognised.

Two tie-breaks the design leaves open. Payment lines: a method whose lines all have a NULL transdate sorts after any dated method on the earliest-payment tie. Concession: a code that is in silv_ref_concession_type beats one that is not; among known codes the highest apuk_discount wins, then the lowest line recid. -1 Unrecognised results only when no CON line on the segment invoice is known.

No foreign keys were added to the existing silv_membership_events and fact_membership_events. Neither Phase 1 table has foreign keys. A key on fact to the gold dimensions would also break Phase 1 fact inserts while dim_payment_method is empty: it is populated by its load, not seeded. silv_member_year_attributes does have foreign keys to the three silver reference lists, which are seeded. The new columns on the Phase 1 table files are lower case to match the existing code; the old naming findings on those files are left as they were.

The fixed values sit in one place at the top of the load: the seeded reference ids (Corporate method 5, Individual 1, Corporate payer 2, No concession 1), the first invoice year 2022 (Q-011) and the active status 'Active' (Q-027).
notes:
MOD-007 builds:
- Layercake.vw_silv_eligible_invoice. Columns: contact_no, campaign_year, rec_id, invoice, voucher, trans_date, inv_payment_method, inv_currency, is_fully_credited, is_full_concession, invoice_seq (ascending trans_date with NULL first, ties by rec_id) and is_segment_invoice.
- Layercake.silv_member_year_attributes, keyed on (contact_no, campaign_year).
- Layercake.usp_load_silv_member_year_attributes @run_id, @as_of_date. It recomputes every row and writes only differences (delete, update, insert in one transaction). The scheme number is compared as bytes, so a change in case alone is still written. An as-of date with no row in ref_campaign_year_config raises error 50001, which names the date, after logging Failed.
- Change scripts adding the 17 columns to silv_membership_events and fact_membership_events. Keys and flags have named defaults of 0; the down script drops the defaults and the columns.

Final run: 55 Tester tests and 9 developer tests pass. The round-trip passes. The checks pass; sqlfluff findings are advisory only, mostly layout and capitalisation.

Data risk carried over from MOD-006: if two concession types share one item code, the load picks one per the concession tie-break rather than failing.

No grants are needed: the module adds no gold object.
